lng_dataset.concept: U.S. liquefied natural gas exports (not feedgas)
lng_dataset.release_cadence: Monthly EIA Natural Gas Monthly / dnav hist_xls republish. Typical publish lag ~1–3 months after the reference month.

point_in_time_safety.alignment: YoY/seasonal transforms computed on native monthly dates or past-only weekly as-of levels; as-of forward-fill onto weekly price dates. Full-sample z-score is leaky and used only as contrast.

lng_dataset.revisions_policy: EIA monthly series can be revised in subsequent Natural Gas Monthly releases. HPTL stores the latest downloaded hist_xls snapshot; it does not retain a vintage/point-in-time revision archive. Validation treats the current cache as the working series (standard for this pillar).
lng_dataset.economic_rationale: Stronger LNG export volumes tighten the domestic balance and are typically supportive for Henry Hub / NG prices (positive coefficient).
